claims.text: BERT was compared to other established machine-learning algorithms in the task of sensitive data detection and classification.
Experiments were conducted with other systems and baselines to evaluate BERT's performance.
The BERT-based model outperformed other systems in the NUBes-PHI dataset without requiring domain-specific feature engineering.
